page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores using the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 7 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the top 25% at 3073.98. Multi-core performance, passmark CPU score, and database operations fall within the average range. However, a notable hardware tradeoff is observed in memory bandwidth; while cached small-block reads perform at an average level of 1216.93 GB/sec, uncached large-block reads are weak, measuring at 39.07 GB/sec, which places it in the bottom 25% of tested hardware.

This instance offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads. It is well-suited for applications such as web serving, database operations, and multi-threaded decompression tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, making it a reliable choice for enterprise applications that require predictable compute power without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or compute-optimized hardware.
